children: Profusa entered into a financing, issuing a senior secured convertible note to Ascent Partners Fund for $350,000 in proceeds (face value $384,615.38) to bolster liquidity. The note carries 7% cash interest, matures as early as Sep 16, 2027, and is convertible at $4.28 per share, with a $1.07 floor subject to adjustment. Amortization begins Jan 1, 2027, with potential share payments subject to conditions, and 33% of net proceeds from any subsequent offering must prepay the note. The obligations are secured by substantially all assets; upon default, interest rises to 18%.
: Through Sep 16 2027, subject to earlier Option Closing Date
